$comment: Project settings, committed on purpose -- unlike settings.local.json, which a
global ignore rule keeps out of the repository and which therefore never
`R:\Temp` is the RAM disk .claude/windows-role.md tells the Windows sessions to
do their scratch work on. That put every screenshot and capture they take
outside the working directory, so reading their own evidence back asked for
permission every time -- 56 times in the section 32 / 37 run. Telling them to
work there and not granting it was half an instruction.
It does nothing on a machine with no R: drive: a path that does not exist
simply never matches, so this is inert on Linux and macOS.
The SessionStart hook keeps a cloud session's disk from filling with build
output (scripts/cloud-session-start.sh). It exits at once anywhere else, and
`|| true` keeps a machine without bash from seeing it fail.
